{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that American diplomatic leadership is critical to maximizing the benefits of technological innovation while minimizing its risks and dislocations.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will avoid a race to the bottom, where countries hostile to democratic values shape the future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will mobilize public and private actors to ensure that new products and new discoveries are bound by law, ethics, and civil liberties protections that enable democratic societies to thrive and prosperity to be shared broadly.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will recommit the United States to the principles of an open internet, including net neutrality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will vigorously oppose efforts to digitally silo off countries and populations from the rest of the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that algorithms and platforms should empower people instead of the surveillance state.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats expect technology companies and social media platforms to take responsibility and do more to preserve the openness of democratic societies and identify foreign disinformation, especially including paid efforts to influence American elections through advertising or coordinated inauthentic behavior.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take steps to prevent the use of new technologies to facilitate repression, spread hate, or incite violence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
